cards.ex: We need to iron out a few details before the deal is finalized.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv yakunlanishidan oldin, biz bir nechta tafsilotlarni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki kelishmovchilikni hal qilish, tuzatish.

cards.ex: Most of her problems stem from a lack of communication.
cards.exUz: Uning muammolarining aksariyati aloqa yetishmasligidan kelib chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sababi bo'lmoq, boshlanishi.

cards.ex: Companies often find ways to get around environmental regulations.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar ko'pincha atrof-muhit qoidalarini chetlab o'tish yo'llarini topadilar.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni chetlab o'tish, qonunni buzmasdan undan qochish.

cards.ex: Don't get bogged down in the details; focus on the main issues.
cards.exUz: Tafsilotlarda botqoqqa botmang; asosiy masalalarga e'tibor qarating.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsada ortiqcha qiyinchiliklarga duch kelish, rivojlanishdan to'xtash.

cards.ex: Filing for bankruptcy should be a last resort, not a first option.
cards.exUz: Bankrotlik uchun ariza berish birinchi variant emas, oxirgi chora bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilishning eng oxirgi usuli, boshqa hech narsa qolmaganda.

cards.ex: The project suffered a major setback when the funding was cut.
cards.exUz: Loyiha moliyalashtirish qisqartirilganda katta to'siqqa duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanish yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishishda katta muammo yoki kechikish.

cards.ex: The company needs to address the issue of employee morale.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya xodimlarning kayfiyatini yaxshilash masalasini hal qilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoga e'tibor qaratib, uni hal qilishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Climate change is a thorny issue that requires global cooperation.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi global hamkorlikni talab qiladigan murakkab masaladir.
cards.uzDef: Hal qilish qiyin bo'lgan, ko'plab muammolarni keltirib chiqaradigan masala.

cards.ex: We need to identify the root cause of the problem before we can fix it.
cards.exUz: Muammoni hal qilishdan oldin uning asosiy sababini aniqlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning asosiy sababi, boshqa muammolar uning natijasidir.

cards.ex: We need to think outside the box to solve this crisis.
cards.exUz: Ushbu inqirozni hal qilish uchun biz standartdan tashqari fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va noodatiy yechimlarni o'ylab topish.

cards.ex: I'm at a crossroads in my career; I don't know what to do.
cards.exUz: Men kareramda chorrahadaman; nima qilishni bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Muhim qaror qabul qilish kerak bo'lgan vaziyatda.

cards.ex: It's a lose-lose situation; whatever we do, someone will be unhappy.
cards.exUz: Bu yutqazish vaziyati; nima qilsak ham, kimdir xursand bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hech kim yuta olmaydigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: I need to get my finances sorted before I buy a house.
cards.exUz: Uy sotib olishdan oldin moliyaviy ahvolimni tartibga solishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilmoq, vaziyatni tartibga keltirmoq.

cards.ex: We're finally making headway on the project.
cards.exUz: Biz nihoyat loyihada oldinga siljiyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilishda sekin-asta muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq.

cards.ex: The company's debt is the elephant in the room that no one wants to discuss.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning qarzi - hech kim muhokama qilishni istamaydigan asosiy muammo.
cards.uzDef: Hamma biladigan, lekin gapirishdan qochadigan asosiy muammo.

cards.ex: The strike threw a wrench in our plans for the conference.
cards.exUz: Ish tashlash konferentsiya rejamizni buzdi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalarni buzadigan kutilmagan muammo yaratmoq.

cards.ex: Off the top of my head, I can't think of a solution.
cards.exUz: Bir zumda yechim o'ylab topa olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa haqida chuqur o'ylamasdan, bir zumda aytmoq.

cards.ex: The language barrier was a major stumbling block to communication.
cards.exUz: Til to'sig'i aloqaga katta to'siq edi.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanishga xalaqit beradigan narsa, muammo.

cards.ex: The product failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Mahsulot muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, shuning uchun boshidan rejalashtiramiz.
cards.uzDef: Muammo hal bo'lmagan holda, yangi yechimlar izlash maqsadida boshidan boshlash.

cards.ex: Choosing the lesser of two evils is sometimes the only option.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan ikki yomon variantdan eng kam yomonini tanlash yagona imkoniyatdir.
cards.uzDef: Ikki yomon variantdan eng kam yomonini tanlash.

cards.ex: The economy seems to have turned the corner after a long recession.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot uzoq davom etgan tanazzuldan so'ng burilish nuqtasiga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning eng yomon qismi ortda qolganini anglatuvchi vaziyat.

cards.ex: The company has been in the doldrums for the past few months.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya so'nggi bir necha oy davomida turg'unlikda bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ishlar sustlashgan, faoliyat past bo'lgan davr.

cards.ex: Her pleas for help fell on deaf ears.
cards.exUz: Uning yordam so'rashlari e'tiborga olinmadi.
cards.uzDef: Eshitildi, lekin e'tiborga olinmadi yoki javob bermadi.

cards.ex: After missing so many deadlines, he's walking on thin ice.
cards.exUz: Ko'p muddatlarni o'tkazib yuborganidan so'ng, u nozik muzda yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda, xato qilish oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The government is grappling with rising inflation and unemployment.
cards.exUz: Hukumat inflyatsiya va ishsizlikning o'sishi bilan kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyat yoki muammoga qarshi kurashish, yechim topishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Losing my job was tough, but the silver lining is I now have time to pursue my passion.
cards.exUz: Ishdan ayrilish qiyin bo'ldi, lekin yaxshi tomoni shundaki, endi o'z ishtiyoqim bilan shug'ullanishga vaqtim bor.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday yomon vaziyatda ham yaxshi bir narsa topish mumkinligiga ishora.

cards.ex: I'm in a real quandary about whether to accept the new job offer.
cards.exUz: Men yangi ish taklifini qabul qilish yoki qilmaslik haqida juda ikkilanyapman.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish qiyin bo'lgan vaziyatda, ikkilanish holatida bo'lish.

cards.ex: Many small businesses have fallen victim to the economic downturn.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina kichik bizneslar iqtisodiy tanazzul qurboni bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon narsaning ta'siriga tushib qolish, salbiy oqibatga uchrash.

cards.ex: The company has a nagging problem with employee morale.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyada xodimlarning ruhiy holati bilan bog'liq bezovta qiluvchi muammo bor.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri hal qilinmayotgan va bezovta qiluvchi muammo.

cards.ex: I'm trying to get to grips with the new software.
cards.exUz: Men yangi dasturiy ta'minotni tushunishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunishga harakat qilish, o'rganib chiqish va nazorat qilish.
